questions.prompt: The side opposite the right angle in a right-angled triangle is called the ______.
questions.explanation: It is called the hypotenuse — always the longest side.

questions.prompt: The two sides that meet at the right angle of a right-angled triangle are called the ______ of the triangle.
questions.explanation: They are called the legs (or catheti).

questions.prompt: Testing whether a triangle is right-angled using only its three side lengths uses the ______ of Pythagoras' theorem.
questions.explanation: This is called the converse of the theorem.
